out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED A SANITIZER BUCKET IN THE HANDWASHING SINK AT THE BAR.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN (6): COOKED RICE NOODLES AT 53F, COOKED TOFU AT 61F, RAW SPROUTS AT 54F OBSERVED IN (8) COOKED RICE AT 53F, CUT CABBAGE AT 44-45F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: TCS FOODS LISTED ABOVE DISPOSED OF.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution. Observed machine at 0 ppm
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. PIC agreed to have the dish machine repaired, will follow up to verify compliance

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: plastic Tupperware was not sanitized
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC stopped employee and had them make sanitizer

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: cabbage, lettuce, and bean sprouts kept out on counter
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. PIC disposed of food and reset new foods, marked with 4 hour endpoint

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: rice scoops being stored in standing non-heated water
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC disposed of water

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Design Features
violations.observation: The backflow or backsiphonage prevention device installed on the @EQUIPMENT@ is not identified as meeting standards set by the American Society of Sanitary Engineering. ( observed on the mop sink)
violations.corrective_action: A backflow or back siphonage prevention device installed on a water supply system shall meet American Society of Sanitary Engineering (A.S.S.E.) standards for construction, installation, maintenance, inspection, and testing for that specific application and type of device. PIC agreed to replace splitter its approved backflow prevention device

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair

violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PIC agreed to repair the 3 vat sink.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Windows or doors kept open for ventilation or other purposes do not have openings that are adequately protected against the entry of insects or rodents observed rear door the facility is open to a separate business, with no effective barrier against pest entry
violations.corrective_action: Windows or doors kept open for ventilation or other purposes shall have openings that are adequately protected against the entry of insects or rodents by 1) 16 mesh to 25.4mm (16 mesh to 1 inch) screens; 2) properly designed and installed air curtains to control flying insects; or 3) other effective means person in charge closed to rear door to the kitchen agreed to keep it closed from the separate business.

violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW SHELL EGGS OVER TOFU IN WIC PRODUCE, OBSERVED RAW SHELL EGGS OVER RTE FOOD IN 2DR UC LEFT.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. -CFM MOVED EGGS TO BOTTOM SHELF OF BOTH UNITS.
